en-US.title: PanelUI
en-US.subtitle: React Native UI components
en-US.description:
PanelUI is a catalogue of the PanelUI component library for React Native and Expo, running natively on your phone. Every component is live: press it, drag it, type into it and switch its theme, then copy the same component into your own app.

What's inside

• More than 100 components — buttons, inputs, sheets, dialogs, menus, toasts, tables, calendars, carousels and more, each shown in every variant.
• Charts — line, area, bar, pie, ring, radar, heatmap, sankey and others, drawn natively and animated on the UI thread.
• Blocks — whole screens composed from the components, such as a boarding pass, a wallet and a smart-home controller, ready to take into a project.
• Themes — three theme families, each in light and dark, applied to every screen at once.

Who it is for

Developers and designers building with React Native who want to see how a component looks and behaves on a real device before using it. Each component in the app has a documentation page at panelui.dev and can be installed from npm as panelui-native, or copied into a project with the PanelUI CLI.

No account is needed, and the app collects no personal data.
en-US.promoText: Try more than 100 React Native components and ready-made screens live on your phone, in every theme, before you add them to your app.
